org.portico.bindings.jgroups.channel

Class Channel

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.bindings.jgroups.channel.Channel

  • public class Channel
extends Object
    This class represents a channel devoted to supporting an active Portico Federation. The purpose of this class is primarily just to handle the JGroups-specific comms. Any broader logic should be handled by the Federation class in which this sits. For outgoing messages, we have `sendXxxx` methods. For incoming messages we set up an instance of a ChannelListener which then routes incoming messages back to the Federation, once any JGroups stuff has been stripped away.

      • connect

        public void connect()
             throws JRTIinternalError
        Create the underlying JGroups channel and connect to it. If we have WAN support enabled then we will create a slightly different protocol stack based on the configuration. Should we be unable to create or connect to the channel, a generic internal error exception will be thrown.
        Throws:
        JRTIinternalError

      • send

        public void send(byte[] payload)
          throws JRTIinternalError
        This method will send the provided message to all federates connected to the same JGroups channel. If there is a problem sending the message, a JRTIinternalError is thrown. No special flags are set on these messages. They are asynchronous, subject to flow control and bundling.
        Parameters:
        message - The message to be sent.
        Throws:
        JRTIinternalError - If there is a problem serializing or sending the message

      • sendFindCoordinator

        public void sendFindCoordinator()
                         throws Exception
        Sends out a "Find Coordinator" control message to try and locate the process that is acting as the coordinator for this federation/channel. This method just sends the request and immediately returns. Responses, if there are any, will come in asynchronously.
        Throws:
        Exception
